facts.name: EndUI_ShowSaveIcon_Static(world, kind)
facts.note: The save-data notice shown with the kind's text (0 the check's); a no-op while it is up. Entry %16=0 in both builds.

facts.name: EndUI_HideSaveIcon_Static(nextKind)
facts.note: Collapses the notice at once after two seconds up (or at two seconds through the tick); nextKind 0 nothing after. Entry %16=4 / 8.

facts.name: UEndTextBlock_SetText_FStringPtr(block, FString*)
facts.note: Copies the string into the block and frees the caller's buffer (ME_FreeResourceBindingArray). The 1.005 prologue differs from 1.004's (the table carries this build's bytes). Entry %16=4 / 8.
